high_risk_sources.name: Open Library API
caveats: Covers are not all openly licensed; check per image.
No reliable global sales or quality ranking is included.

high_risk_sources.name: Internet Archive APIs
caveats: Do not redistribute in-copyright or lending-only items.

high_risk_sources.name: Semantic Scholar API
caveats: Commercial use may require an agreement; verify before production use.

high_risk_sources.name: CORE API
caveats: Free access is primarily intended for research; check commercial terms.

high_risk_sources.name: Europe PMC REST API
caveats: Not all records are open access.

high_risk_sources.name: NCBI E-utilities (PubMed)
caveats: Do not assume abstracts are freely redistributable.

high_risk_sources.name: Zenodo API
caveats: Always inspect the licence of the individual record.

high_risk_sources.name: World Values Survey
caveats: Commercial use and redistribution require checking the current WVSA terms.

high_risk_sources.name: UN Comtrade API
caveats: Free access is limited; large extractions may require a subscription.

high_risk_sources.name: UNdata
caveats: API availability varies by database. Do not assume a single REST endpoint.

high_risk_sources.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
caveats: Non-commercial restriction is significant for a commercial platform. Seek written permission or use World Bank/OWID alternatives.

high_risk_sources.name: UNICEF Data
caveats: Bulk files and APIs vary by indicator; check each dataset page.

high_risk_sources.name: ReliefWeb API
caveats: Reports are copyrighted by their publishers; do not republish full text without permission.

high_risk_sources.name: Hugging Face Hub API
caveats: Download counts are inflated by CI, mirrors and evaluation harnesses.
Each model has its own licence, often non-commercial or gated.

high_risk_sources.name: OMDb API
caveats: Ratings are licensed from IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes; do not redistribute as your own dataset.

high_risk_sources.name: Jikan API
caveats: Unofficial dependency; MAL can change or block access. Not suitable as a sole commercial source.

high_risk_sources.name: AniList GraphQL API
caveats: GraphQL POST required; check terms before commercial use.

high_risk_sources.name: Steam Web API
caveats: No official global sales data; concurrent players are a partial proxy.

high_risk_sources.name: Last.fm API
caveats: Commercial use likely requires an agreement; verify.

high_risk_sources.name: Spotify Web API
caveats: Spotify's developer terms restrict commercial use and data storage. Not suitable for an open commercial rankings dataset without an agreement.

high_risk_sources.name: The Guardian Open Platform
caveats: Free tier is for non-commercial use; article text cannot be republished wholesale.

high_risk_sources.name: NewsAPI
caveats: Free plan is explicitly non-commercial and not for production.

high_risk_sources.name: Chess.com Published-Data API
caveats: Published-data API is not a complete historical archive.

high_risk_sources.name: football-data.org
caveats: Free tier excludes some major competitions and has limited history.

high_risk_sources.name: MLB Stats API
caveats: Unofficial public endpoint; could change without notice.

high_risk_sources.name: Jolpica F1 API
caveats: Community service with no SLA; verify results against official F1 sources.

high_risk_sources.name: CoinMarketCap API
caveats: Free tier is for personal/development use only.

high_risk_sources.name: UNESCO World Heritage Convention
caveats: Reference source only. Do not scrape at scale without permission.

high_risk_sources.name: QS World University Rankings
caveats: Cannot be harvested or republished without a QS licence. Use OpenAlex bibliometrics for an independent proxy.

high_risk_sources.name: Times Higher Education World University Rankings
caveats: Cannot be republished without a licence.

high_risk_sources.name: MICHELIN Guide
caveats: Reference only; republication requires a Michelin licence.

high_risk_sources.name: IMDb Datasets
caveats: Explicitly non-commercial. Cannot be used by a commercial platform without an IMDb licence.

high_risk_sources.name: Numbeo
caveats: Crowd-sourced data; commercial reuse needs a licence.

high_risk_sources.name: Kaggle Datasets
caveats: A discovery layer, not a rights clearance. Verify each dataset licence and provenance.

high_risk_sources.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
caveats: Country coverage and year coverage are uneven.

high_risk_sources.name: GBIF API
caveats: Occurrence records are presence-only and biased by observer effort.
Licence must be checked per dataset; some are non-commercial.

high_risk_sources.name: iNaturalist API
caveats: Citizen-science data has strong geographic and taxonomic bias.

high_risk_sources.name: eBird API
caveats: Check eBird data use terms; bulk access may require an application.

high_risk_sources.name: Protected Planet
caveats: Boundary data quality varies by country.

high_risk_sources.name: Open-Meteo
caveats: Free tier is non-commercial only. A commercial licence is required for this platform.

high_risk_sources.name: BPS-Statistics Indonesia API
caveats: Provincial series are revised; record the BPS table and publication date.

high_risk_sources.name: INEGI API
caveats: State-level GDP is published with a lag and revised; record the reference year.

high_risk_sources.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria
caveats: State-level series are incomplete and often published only in PDF tables.
